clause_by_clause_review.producer_reason_reviewed: Establishment, five private-sector members and designation of the Chairman are all features of the Commission that terminates under amended section 4(b).
Advice to AID and progress reports to the Deputy Secretary of State are Commission functions. The prior statutory commission's May 16, 1992 end is contextual, not this Commission's ending.
AID funding is specifically funding for this Commission and has no separate prospective authorization once it ends.
Uncompensated service and statutory travel expenses are tied to work on the Commission. Existing travel claims may accrue; no new Commission work follows the amended sunset.
Reimbursable administrative services require this Commission's Chairman's request and AID's judgment, so the prospective authority depends on this Commission.
Procurement authority belongs to the Commission Chairman through AID and concerns temporary/intermittent services; it does not set up a continuing independent procurement program.
The FACA delegation to AID is expressly for functions applicable to this Commission and ceases prospectively with that body.

EO12815 expressly substitutes December 31, 1992 for September 30, 1992. The substituted not-later-than sunset closes the Commission absent evidence of a legally earlier ending; no report date or amendment signing date is used as an end.

inventory_review.scope_note: All reconstructed operative scopes compared against the full held original. No omitted independent command located.

limits: This is AI source review, not an eo-lifecycle-review/v1 independent_human record.
Prospective-authority cessation can be supported while the exact submitted complete first-end claim is rejected.
Original page-image confirmation is not asserted; three EO13350 legal-body rendered pages were independently inspected.
rationale: The complete eight-scope reconstructed inventory is supported by original spans. Advice and progress reports, funding, travel, support, procurement and FACA administration are Commission-dependent; the predecessor commission termination on May 16, 1992 does not terminate the new commission. The proposed exact December 31, 1992 first-end fields are not supported by the not-later-than clause. The prospective Commission functions cease by that bound, but this does not uphold the exact submitted whole-lifecycle claim.

required_corrections_or_open_tasks.reason: Original section 4(b) says “shall terminate not later than September 30, 1992.” EO12815 substitutes December 31, 1992 only; it does not replace “not later than” or establish the actual day the Commission ceased. EO12869 says committees have terminated or completed work without supplying an actual earlier date. Bounded absence of a located earlier act does not turn an outer bound into an affirmative exact first cessation.
required_corrections_or_open_tasks.required_correction: Retain cessation no later than December 31, 1992 as a bound and September 30, 1993 as the later formal revocation. Supply actual terminal/continuation evidence establishing an exact first cessation for each function, or withdraw approval and keep this case unable under the exact-date schema. Do not assign the later revocation as a substitute first end.
required_corrections_or_open_tasks.scopes: all eight submitted scopes and whole_order_end
